claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current release is policy-compliant and evidentially supported despite a known below-target small-business onboarding segment remaining exposed during rollout.
decision_criteria: If the affected use case remains exposed, certification is compliant only with reviewed risk acceptance that explicitly justifies that exposure.
If the affected use case is excluded from rollout, monitoring and rollback controls can support a limited launch posture.
Aggregate launch readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient when a material model-card weakness remains exposed.
Disclosure of the limitation is required but does not substitute for exclusion or approved risk acceptance under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: Provide reviewed and approved risk acceptance that explicitly addresses the exposed small-business onboarding segment and explains why exposure is acceptable before launch.
Provide evidence that the rollout excludes the affected small-business onboarding use case or segment until the weakness is resolved.
Provide the actual material limitation disclosure that will be attached to the launch decision for the named use case.
Provide evidence that the below-target segment issue has been remediated to target if certification is still sought without risk acceptance.
specific_concerns: The policy requires either exclusion of the affected use case or reviewed risk acceptance for exposed rollout; the actor summary says neither condition is satisfied.
The affected small-business onboarding segment remains below target and is still exposed in the initial rollout.
The available risk-acceptance document is described as incomplete and not fully approved, so it does not satisfy the policy predicate.
Aggregate readiness, a 6% rollout, monitoring, and rollback controls do not cure the missing policy requirement when the affected segment remains exposed.
The actor packet overclaims by framing certification as supportable on a limited basis even though the stated facts fail the policy threshold.
unsupported_claims: Certification is supportable on a limited basis under the available admissible evidence.
Launch readiness and reversibility controls provide enough operational containment to proceed while the limitation is explicitly documented and closely monitored.
The packet supports certification of the current release using aggregate readiness evidence and phased rollout controls despite the unresolved exposed segment.
